{{Quote|Ask your chief executive about his interest in Twi'lek artistic pursuits on every fourth of the month, and if he'd like me to give police surveillance holovids of the visits to the cultural center to his lovely wife. Your call.|CSF Captain Jaller Obrim, dealing with an obstructing administrative medical droid|<ref name="Republic Commando: True Colors">''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]''</ref>}}
An '''individual''' worked during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] as the chief executive of the [[Republic Central Medcenter/Legends|Republic Central Medcenter]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. He was under observation by the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force's]] [[Anti-Terrorism Unit]]. They had several surveillance [[Holovid/Legends|holovids]] of him visiting [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Prostitute/Legends|prostitutes]] on the fourth day of every month.
